description: Search recent bookings by a guest's name. Returns matching bookings with their date/time, party size, status, and contact info. Useful for 'find Julie Kohlhoff's booking', 'when is the wedding party scheduled?', etc.

days.description: How many days back to search. Default 60.

name.description: A first name, last name, or partial name to search for. Case-insensitive.

name: find_booking_by_guest_name
